title: 2026 waste-incinerator R1 energy-efficiency QA controls

sources.title: Waste incinerator plant: apply for R1 status

sources.publisher: Department for Environment Food and Rural Affairs
sources.title: Energy from waste: changing the energy efficiency formula (R1 formula)

facts.source_fact: Waste incineration is normally classified as a disposal operation unless the applicable R1 recovery criteria are met.
facts.expected_handling: Keep disposal/recovery classification separate from raw energy data.

facts.source_fact: Eligible municipal-waste incinerators can be classified as recovery operations when they meet the R1 energy-efficiency threshold.
facts.expected_handling: Require eligible-facility and threshold evidence before recovery classification.

facts.source_fact: R1 applications relate to facilities operating under an environmental permit.
facts.expected_handling: Bind R1 evidence to the correct permitted facility.

facts.source_fact: The R1 route applies to qualifying mixed-municipal-waste incineration facilities and excludes co-incinerators from the specific route.
facts.expected_handling: Apply facility-type scope before calculation.

facts.source_fact: Municipal-waste-incinerator status can include qualifying commercial and industrial waste circumstances described by the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve waste-stream and facility classification evidence.

facts.source_fact: Operators must calculate the R1 energy-efficiency value using the prescribed formula and supporting information.
facts.expected_handling: Store calculation inputs and formula version with the output.

facts.source_fact: The R1 threshold is 0.60 for installations permitted before 1 January 2009 under the applicable rule.
facts.expected_handling: Attach permit vintage before applying the threshold.

facts.source_fact: The R1 threshold is 0.65 for installations permitted after 31 December 2008 under the applicable rule.
facts.expected_handling: Attach permit vintage before applying the threshold.

facts.source_fact: The guidance specifies the applicable 0.60 threshold for qualifying automotive-shredder-residue incineration circumstances.
facts.expected_handling: Apply the ASR-specific scope before using this threshold.

facts.source_fact: The R1 calculation can require the prescribed climate-correction factor.
facts.expected_handling: Keep climate-correction provenance and version with the calculation.

facts.source_fact: An R1 application includes the calculated R1 value and supporting technical evidence.
facts.expected_handling: Do not accept a recovery-status claim without calculation evidence.

facts.source_fact: Supporting evidence includes an energy-flow or Sankey diagram where required by the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Retain energy-flow provenance with calculation inputs.

facts.source_fact: A pre-commission application may use a design-stage R1 value subject to later operational validation.
facts.expected_handling: Label design values as provisional rather than operational performance.

facts.source_fact: Boiler-efficiency acceptance testing is used to validate relevant design assumptions after commissioning.
facts.expected_handling: Link acceptance-test evidence to the operational R1 calculation.

facts.source_fact: The guidance requires an updated calculation within 3 months of receiving the acceptance-test results.
facts.expected_handling: Track the recalculation due date.

facts.source_fact: R1 status requires ongoing annual operating-data review and submission under the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Version R1 values by operating year.

facts.source_fact: Where an annual value falls below the threshold, any extension or continued-status case requires the evidence described by the guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Do not silently carry forward recovery status after a below-threshold result.

facts.source_fact: A facility can lose R1 recovery status if it remains below the required threshold after the permitted process.
facts.expected_handling: Represent status as time-varying and evidence-based.

facts.source_fact: Boiler efficiency must be reassessed every 5 years and sent to the Environment Agency within 6 months of the fifth anniversary of the previous assessment.
facts.expected_handling: Track reassessment date and current validity.

facts.source_fact: The current guidance was updated in 2026 for fees and for the commissioned-plant recalculation clarification.
facts.expected_handling: Version fee and procedural information and do not treat fees as emissions data.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve cited R1 facts and units.
Attach facility type, waste stream, permit vintage and calculation scope.
Attach calculation year, permit date, guidance date and reassessment validity.
Carry formula, climate factor, Sankey and test provenance.
Do not convert facility R1 classification into parcel-level measured emissions.
